_comment: The three repositories and what each path is for, one line each — the source of the wiki's repository map (docs/reference/repo-map.md). tools/gen_repo_map.py --check proves every platform path exists; sibling paths are checked against their pinned trees when a token is available. Keep purposes to one line; add a path when a newcomer would ask what it is.
